parameters.query:
SELECT
    primary_error_type AS error_type,
    COUNT(*) AS error_count,
    COUNT(*) AS affected_inbound_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbound_orders) AS total_inbound_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM validation_result) AS total_error_event_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM validation_primary_result) AS total_affected_inbound_count
FROM validation_primary_result
GROUP BY primary_error_type
ORDER BY error_count DESC, error_type;

INSERT INTO workflow_run_log (
    workflow_name,
    detail_report_path,
    summary_report_path,
    total_error_count,
    status
)
SELECT
    'ERP Inbound Validation Pipeline',
    '/files/reports/validation_result_{{ $now.toFormat("yyyyMMdd") }}.csv',
    '/files/reports/validation_summary_{{ $now.toFormat("yyyyMMdd") }}.csv',
    COUNT(*),
    'SUCCESS'
FROM validation_result;

parameters.query:
WITH summary AS (
    SELECT
        primary_error_type AS error_type,
        COUNT(*) AS error_count
    FROM validation_primary_result
    GROUP BY primary_error_type
),
ranked_samples AS (
    SELECT
        p.inbound_id,
        p.inbound_date,
        p.po_no,
        p.item_code,
        COALESCE(i.item_name, '품목 마스터 미등록') AS item_name,
        p.vendor_code,
        COALESCE(v.vendor_name, '협력사 마스터 미등록') AS vendor_name,
        p.inbound_qty,
        p.primary_error_type AS error_type,
        p.primary_error_message AS error_message,
        p.error_priority,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.primary_error_type) AS error_type_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.primary_error_type
            ORDER BY p.inbound_id
        ) AS sample_rank
    FROM validation_primary_result p
    LEFT JOIN item_master i
        ON p.item_code = i.item_code
    LEFT JOIN vendor_master v
        ON p.vendor_code = v.vendor_code
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbound_orders) AS total_inbound_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM validation_result) AS total_error_event_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM validation_primary_result) AS total_affected_inbound_count,
    (
        SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(s))
        FROM (
            SELECT
                error_type,
                error_count
            FROM summary
            ORDER BY error_count DESC, error_type
        ) s
    ) AS summary_rows,
    (
        SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(x))
        FROM (
            SELECT
                inbound_id,
                inbound_date,
                po_no,
                item_code,
                item_name,
                vendor_code,
                vendor_name,
                inbound_qty,
                error_type,
                error_message,
                error_type_count
            FROM ranked_samples
            WHERE sample_rank = 1
            ORDER BY error_type_count DESC, error_priority, inbound_id
            LIMIT 5
        ) x
    ) AS priority_samples;
